data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's discrete-bundle route (3 bundles × $2 = $6) reduces to SRC_002's uniform-scaling mechanism, because each bundle of 7 at $2 instantiates the same constant unit rate $2/7, and the linear function is the unique continuous extension of the discrete bundle points. REFUTED IF: the bundle price is a strict atomic lot with no extractable unit rate (i.e., $2 is not divisible by 7), or if 21 pencils cannot be decomposed into exactly three valid bundles.
